facts.en: Earned a BA in Geography at Fictional Institute D022 in 2018.
facts.zh: 2018 年在虚构院校 D022 获得地理学文学学士学位。

facts.en: Worked as a parks booking coordinator at Fictional Employer D022 from 2019-04 to 2026-06.
facts.zh: 2019-04 至 2026-06 在虚构雇主 D022 担任公园预约协调员。

facts.en: Used spreadsheet pivot tables to summarize venue usage by weekday and booking category.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格数据透视表，按星期和预约类别汇总场地使用情况。

facts.en: Reconciled 240 booking records for a quarterly review and flagged 17 duplicates; the supervisor approved the final corrections.
facts.zh: 为季度复盘核对 240 条预约记录并标出 17 条重复记录；主管批准最终修正。

facts.en: Completed a self-directed SQL project in 2026-05 using an expressly fictional 800-row booking dataset.
facts.zh: 2026-05 完成自主 SQL 项目，使用明确虚构的 800 行预约数据集。

facts.en: In the project, wrote filtering, GROUP BY and JOIN queries in SQLite, with expected-result checks for 6 queries.
facts.zh: 在该项目中使用 SQLite 编写筛选、GROUP BY 和 JOIN 查询，并为 6 条查询设置预期结果检查。

facts.en: Explained quarterly usage tables to nontechnical venue managers and recorded their questions.
facts.zh: 向非技术背景的场地经理解释季度使用情况表，并记录其问题。

facts.en: Has not used a production business-intelligence platform; the portfolio contains spreadsheets and SQL only.
facts.zh: 未使用过生产环境商业智能平台；作品集仅包含电子表格和 SQL。
